inspected_paths.postprocessing_order: run_hil_full_missions.wait_existing requires all existing participants terminal before finalize; figure subprocess is CPU-only and finishes before the next mission launch.
inspected_paths.online_capture_finish: capture_native.Instrument.visit_Try inserts live stream finish before original host-only final optimize/reporting.
inspected_paths.trajectory_loading: plot_hil_results.load_run streams paired host_reference and returned_estimator_outputs into preallocated numeric pose/time/error arrays; it does not load sensor_events into a whole-recording list.
inspected_paths.output_equality: run_hil_full_missions.check_returned_poses streams actual board and network-return files, checking all six pose channels and input sequence.
inspected_paths.sensor_recording: recording.read_packets yields one length-bounded packet; protocol.unpack validates each packet SHA256 and numeric array envelope.
inspected_paths.terrain_plot: elevation and valid-mask NPYs are memory-mapped; display stride targets about 500 cells along the longest dimension. terrain_plot_mesh.measured_surface scans row bands and only gathers used sampled vertices; NoData cells are not bridged.
inspected_paths.final_graph: Frozen pose_graph delegates to native GTSAM incremental/global and fixed-lag updates; this review is not a measured solver fill-in/RSS bound.

findings: No whole-mission raw sonar packet list was found in the inspected statistics or plotting path.
Direct persistent numeric trajectory-array storage scales with output pose count, not the total size of raw acoustic arrays.
This is a static review, not a full-route runtime memory measurement or guarantee against OOM in native final optimization/rendering.
Current lake and prepared sea maps include measured bathymetry and registered backscatter. They are not purely synthetic reflectivity maps.

The current lake effective subgrid reflectivity amplitude is 0.18. Source code multiplies measured reflectivity by a procedural unresolved-reflectivity factor, then generates noisy simulated sonar observations.
Measured-map provenance, procedural subgrid augmentation, and synthetic sensor observations must be distinguished. These are not physical raw-ping field trials or full-wave acoustic-model validation.
Prior navigation and simulated observations derive from related survey products; this is not an independent held-out-map generalization proof.
